dedupe_keys.name: ugs 1m fine grained urban green space mapping of 31 major cities in china based on the deep learning framework

description: The Sun Yat-Sen University UGS-1m team publishes urban green-space maps for 31 major Chinese cities at approximately one-metre resolution. The Science Data Bank deposit also contains UGSet, a labelled benchmark with 4,554 image samples of 512 by 512 pixels. A separate boundary package and a Shapefile image-frame package document the mapped areas. Version 2 lists city imagery archives alongside the map and benchmark ZIP files, based on 2,179 Google Earth images. The deposit is publicly accessible and free under CC-BY-4.0. Image acquisition dates and the exact encoding of maps inside the archives were not established from the landing page. Those metadata gaps and classification uncertainty matter when estimating current vegetation cover. The maps can help represent vegetation in urban heat and drainage simulations, while UGSet supports assessment of alternative mapping models. They complement the separately published UGSNet architecture. No imagery or data archive was downloaded.
